introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.body: Welcome to Paper Lab! Your privacy is our priority. This Privacy Policy outlines how your data is handled when you use Paper Lab.
introduction.summary: We don't sell data - We don't collect data - We don't track you

noCollect.title: 1. Information We Do Not Collect
noCollect.body: Paper Lab is designed with privacy in mind. We do not collect, store, or share any of your personal data. Here's what that means:

noTelemetry.title: 1.1. No Telemetry
noTelemetry.body: We do not collect any telemetry data or crash reports.
noTelemetry.body2: Paper Lab does not include any analytics or telemetry.

noPersonalData.title: 1.2. No Personal Data Collection
noPersonalData.body: Paper Lab does not collect any personal information such as your IP address or document contents.

noThirdParty.title: 1.3. No Third-Party Tracking
noThirdParty.body: We do not allow third-party trackers or analytics tools to operate within Paper Lab. Your writing activity remains entirely private and is not shared with any third party.

externalConnections.title: 1.4. External connections
externalConnections.body: Paper Lab may make external connections to check for updates or to fetch templates. We do not collect any data from these connections. These connections are necessary for the proper functioning of the app and are not used for tracking or profiling purposes.

localStorage.title: 2. Information Stored Locally on Your Device

browsingData.title: 2.1. Document Data
browsingData.body: Paper Lab stores certain data locally on your device to enhance your writing experience. This includes:

cookies.title: Local Projects
cookies.body: Your projects and documents are stored entirely locally on your device and are not shared with Paper Lab.

cache.title: Cache and Temporary Files
cache.body: Paper Lab may store cache files (like LaTeX compilation artifacts) locally to improve performance.

settings.title: 2.2. Settings and Preferences
settings.body: Any customizations, settings, and preferences you make within Paper Lab are stored locally on your device. We do not have access to or control over this data.

sync.title: 3. Sync Feature
sync.body: Currently, Paper Lab does not have an active cloud sync feature. All data remains on your local file system.

addons.title: 4. Templates and Plugins
addons.body: You can install Templates and Plugins. These are hosted by our services. We do not collect any data from these downloads, they are purely static content.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.body: Although Paper Lab does not collect your data, we are committed to protecting the information that is stored locally on your device. We recommend that you enable device encryption and regularly update your software to ensure your data remains safe.
security.note: Note that your documents are only as secure as your local machine.

control.title: 6. Your Control
control.deletionBody: You have full control over all data stored locally on your device by Paper Lab. You can delete your projects and cache at any time.

website.title: 7. Our Website and Services
website.body: Paper Lab's website and services do not use any third-party analytics, tracking, or CDN services. We do not collect any personal information from users visiting our website.
website.externalLinksBody: Paper Lab may contain links to external websites or services that are not owned or operated by us. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of these sites.

changes.title: 8. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of any significant changes by updating the effective date at the top of this policy. Continued use of Paper Lab after such changes constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.

otherTelemetry.title: 9. Other telemetry
otherTelemetry.body: We disable all telemetry data collection in Paper Lab.

contact.title: 10. Contact Us
contact.body: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or Paper Lab, please contact us at:

introduction.title: Introduction

userContent.title: 2. User Content
userContent.body: You retain all rights to the documents and content you create using Paper Lab. We claim no ownership over your work.

disclaimer.title: 3. Disclaimer of Warranties
disclaimer.body: Paper Lab is provided 'as is' without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that the software will be error-free or uninterrupted.
